caption_L1: Here a line plot is titled Infant mortality rate (under one year old) in China from 1950 to 2020. Along the y-axis, Deaths per 1,000 live births is shown using a linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 200. A linear scale of range 1950 to 2010 can be found on the x-axis, labeled Year.
caption_L2L3: Infant mortality in China was at its highest in 1950 with almost 200 deaths per 1000 live births. Infant mortality was at its lowest at 2010 with around 10 deaths per 1000 live births. The trend in this data is a steep downward trend. Infant mortality rates have fallen a lot since 1950. Between 1950 and 1970 rates rose by around 10 but ever since have continued to fall.
